rows.text: A Grove scholar once had so many ideas that the slow speed of writing with human hands made him lose out on many inspired moments. He therefore made a pen from a small branch of Cerces and various valuable gemstones. That pen can write many times faster than an ordinary pen, but it took so long to develop that its maker died soon after its completion. Nonetheless, that invention still found glory in the annals of history — Since the sages love to punish apprentices by making them copy an essay a few hundred times, all Grove apprentices ended up having one copy of this pen each.
